title.name: beyond the bench: rna, omics & bio-programming

overview.description: The guide's frontier: antibody production, Western/Eastern blots, ELISA, aptamers and mass spec for proteomes; RNA purification, RT-PCR/RT-qPCR and Northern blots for transcriptomes; plus gene switches, omics and advanced biological programming. Pick a thread and go deep.
objectives: survey proteome analysis (Western blot, ELISA, mass spec)
survey RNA workflows (RT-PCR, RT-qPCR, Northern blot)
explore gene switches, omics and advanced biological programming
